mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, created_time, room_code, state, level, description, solved_cnt, `like` FROM QuizRoom WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT q.id AS quiz_id, q.title, q.image, q.level, qqr.quiz_order FROM Quiz_QuizRoom qqr JOIN Quiz q ON qqr.quiz_id = q.id WHERE qqr.quiz_room_id = #{quizRoomId} ORDER BY qqr.quiz_order
SELECT id, user_id, title, created_time, room_code, state, level, description, solved_cnt, `like` FROM QuizRoom WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QuizRoom (user_id, title, level, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{roomCode}, #{state}, #{level}, #{description})
